Machine Learning is a subset of Artificial Intelligence.
Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models.
Classification predicts discrete categories or classes, such as detecting whether an email is spam or not spam.
Regression predicts continuous values, such as predicting house prices or temperature.
Unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns or intrinsic structures in unlabeled input data.
Clustering groups similar data points together without predefined labels.
Reinforcement learning trains an agent to make a sequence of decisions by interacting with an environment to maximize cumulative reward.
